audience: podcasters who host shows on Castos and manage access to their private feeds

useCases.title: Check the latest episodes of each podcast
useCases.text: List the podcasts on the account. List the episodes of one podcast to see their created and publish dates.

useCases.title: Read a show's settings and episode notes
useCases.text: Read the settings of one podcast, and open an episode to read its notes and audio details. List the categories Castos accepts.

useCases.title: Create an episode from an audio link
useCases.text: Create an episode from a public https audio link of up to 40 MB. Check the publish date first, because the episode can publish at once.

useCases.title: Update episode text and podcast metadata
useCases.text: Change the text or settings of an episode, or the metadata of a podcast. Only the fields you pass are changed.

useCases.title: Manage private feed subscribers
useCases.text: Find a subscriber by email and read its subscriptions. Add an email as a private subscriber, or revoke one subscription.
